  PROBLEM: The summariser timeout default was doubled from 600 seconds to 1200 seconds in both the workflow and helper script.
  WHY: Reviewers mostly treated this as an operational resource tradeoff rather than a correctness bug, but it still doubles how long a stuck summariser can occupy the job.
